mentions.name: Zigpoll
mentions.description: Zigpoll is a survey and polling platform the author has been building for about four years as a one-person operation, using AI to become competitive with larger incumbents. The business is targeting $2M ARR this year with a possible future sale.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Zigpoll[0] for ~4 years. AI has changed my trajectory dramatically where it's way more realistic to compete with the big players as a one man show. Trying to close out on 2M ARR this year and then maybe look to sell and ride off into the sunset.

mentions.name: Zigpoll
mentions.description: Zigpoll is a business being scaled by its solo founder to $2M ARR, currently at $1.5M ARR. Recent product gains have come from agentic coding, while major growth has come from marketing and exploring alternative growth channels.
mentions.problem: Doubling ARR each year brings a whole new set of challenges layered on top of changes in the tech landscape, and keeping momentum requires constant output from all angles.
